title: Bosses
wikitext:
{{Terminology Infobox |title = Boss Challenge |image = Icon Boss Challenge.png |type = Challenge Types }}'''Boss Challenges''' are [[Challenges]] that award [[Resonator Ascension Material]]s and feature [[Overlord Class]] [[Enemy|Enemies]] and [[Echoes]]. Claiming rewards from Bosses cost {{Item|Waveplate|x=60}}. All bosses respawn 2 minutes after they were first loaded and they will respawn even if the player is nearby or in a menu. The option to claim rewards will also disappear after the boss respawns. The exact time remaining until the boss respawns can be seen by clicking on the boss on the map. __TOC__ ==List of Boss Challenges== {{Bosses by Category Table|Overlord}} ==Possible Drops== There is currently no datamine showing possible drop rates. One particular community project is currently crowdsourcing data regarding drop rates.
